aarti.tek: Victory to you, Mother Śītalā; victory to you, Mother Śītalā. Primal light, great queen, you give every fruit.
aarti.pad1: You shine on a jewelled throne, and a white canopy looks lovely; Ṛddhi and Siddhi together wave chowries, and your glittering beauty spreads over all. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Viṣṇu stands serving you, and Śiva and Brahmā serve you; the Vedas and Purāṇas describe you, but cannot reach your end. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Indra plays the mṛdaṅga, the Moon has the vīṇā in his hand; the Sun beats time, and the sage Nārada sings. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Bells, conches and the shehnai sound, pleasing to the mind; devotees perform the āratī and rejoice as they gaze and gaze on you. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You are Brahman in form, the giver of boons; you alone know the three times. You give happiness to your devotees, and are their mother, father and brother. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever fixes his mind in meditation gains love and strength; he attains every wish and crosses the ocean of worldly existence. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever, afflicted by disease, comes to your refuge: one with leprosy gains a clean body, and one who is blind gains sight. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: The childless woman gains a son, and poverty is cut away; whoever does not worship her beats his head and repents. ॥8॥
aarti.pad9: You alone bring coolness to people; you alone are the protector of the world. Creation, the maiden Bālā, destruction: you are the mother of all. ॥9॥
aarti.pad10: Mother, your servant Nārāyaṇa prays with joined hands: give me devotion to you, Mother, and nothing else. ॥10॥
